name: Warehouse-Breach-View-From-Left-Wall
visual_desc: Camera at WEST wall looking EAST across bay. Far east cracked wall and bent column. Breach glow toward north side of frame. Collapsed shelving toward south side. Dust motes in dawn beams. Empty floor. No people. Match style. Opposite side angle: cracked wall, bent column, dawn dust motes in breach beams, collapsed shelving; empty fighting floor.
